issues.detail: The Greek 'ανεκτοτερον' (antektoteron) means 'more tolerable/endurable,' but the Vietnamese 'khoan hồng' means 'lenient/merciful.' In the context of judgment, 'tolerable' refers to the severity of the punishment being bearable, whereas 'khoan hồng' implies a judicial mercy or reduction of guilt, which is a shift in the nature of the concept.
